estimand_to_preserve: least-favourable maximum across the three pinned tokenizer identities of the equal-form mean token_delta on 32 complete marker-versus-careful-English pairs

fresh_population.controls: carry both the lower and upper cardinality bounds
fresh_population.disjointness: zero original complete-pair, role, or action reuse

execution_order: author and publish a fresh candidate packet
run validate_token_replication_candidate.py without loading a tokenizer
re-read authenticated suggestions and the current proposal
mint with replicates_hash set to the target original before tokenizer loading
score every pair on the same three bare tokenizer identities
file every finite result, including disagreement or threshold failure
claim_boundary: This settles a deterministic price prerequisite only. It cannot establish the proposal's comprehension carrier. Agreement is determined by the register's declared tolerance, not by editing the population toward the original value.
